_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: HIGH #122: deploy.html loads the ZAF SDK from the mutable 2.0 channel with no SRI, regressing closed #94; present in the PUBLISHED v1.0.49 artifact
MEDIUM #123: scripts/security-audit.py:111 hardcodes a two-file page list, so new HTML entry points escape the SDK-integrity check (demonstrated by #122 passing 11/11)
MEDIUM #124: deploy.js splices tsanet_engineer_email / tsanet_connection_name into the bundle JSON unescaped; a double quote injects structure and still parses
MEDIUM #125: shipped docs assert 'ZIS rejects non-admins' as the real boundary behind the client-side admin gate; untested
MEDIUM #96: durable audit trail — direction set (B+C), documentation deliverable sequenced after #101
LOW #98: note attribution heuristic remains open pending Connect-API-Code#131
notes: Delta review of v1.0.49 (nav_bar ZIS bundle deploy screen) against 875fa15. FIRST FULL RUN of the Security Review persona.

Review ran AFTER tag and publish. The pre-tag gate behaved correctly: it compared reviewed_commit to HEAD, detected source changes since the 1.0.48 audit, set COVERED=false, and the published release notes carry the 'NOT covered by a current security review' note. The gate is advisory by design and did not block.
Cat 7 clean on deploy.js: its single innerHTML sink escapes both interpolated values; class/mark are fixed literals.

Cat 2 clean: the shipped bundle carries only placeholders (verified against the published zip) — no real field ids, emails, or hosts. New params are not credentials; tsanet_password remains secure:true. The change REMOVES the API-token requirement.
Cat 1 partial: the new zaf-bundle-sync.yml declares contents:read and pins actions/checkout to a full SHA. The embedded-bundle drift gate does verify the shipped copy equals zis/ source.

Numeric field-id injection was tested and FAILS to parse (the placeholder also appears inside jq strings), so that vector is not exploitable; the quote-break via engineerEmail does parse and is the live one.

NOT verified this session: ZIS rejecting non-admins (no non-admin session); whether ZAF has any admin-only location (Zendesk's locations reference is silent); whether Zendesk audit-logs ZIS registry writes; that private apps do not auto-update (the basis for the 'exposure is currently zero' assessment).
